use_case_summary: Primary driver was fraud-detection with high recall and latency-sensitive scoring at transaction time. Also interested in anonymized transaction summarization and agent-assisted dispute triage. Needed strong data residency and KMS controls to keep PCI-scope off SaaS flows.
latency_throughput_targets: p95 latency < 120ms for single-turn scoring; throughput 500 rps sustained for batch reranking jobs; cost sensitivity moderate but security trumps unit cost.
model_preferences: Prefer Llama- or Mistral-family fine-tuned models; open to quantized 8-bit if HSM/KMS and audit controls are satisfied. Wanted ability to pin model versions and fallback to smaller cheaper variants for non-critical paths.
